correctness.rationale: For every positive rate the 15-transient-state CTMC is absorbing with nonsingular generator. Each four-source rational formula has numerator degree at most 8 and denominator degree at most 5. Exact standard-library Fraction elimination at all 24 positive integer rates, plus the Cramer degree bound (cross-multiplied degree at most 23), proves each displayed rational identity for all positive real rates. Six coefficient identities reconstruct the rational pairwise differences. Three differences and both within-shape differences have strictly positive polynomials, while the sole variable-sign numerator has exactly one positive root by Descartes and opposite integer signs at 5 and 6. Min-order observation follows from unique tree shapes below n=4. Boundary cases and all quantifiers are explicit; finite samples are used only with a valid interpolation bound.

originality.rationale: The statement is the entire four-case site-specific ordering for two four-vertex tree shapes and its unique real-positive crossing, not a generic formula for a Markov-chain hitting time. The inspectable ecological source uses discrete generations and mostly fully occupied starts; the asymptotic contact-process paper concerns growing graphs and full occupancy; the 2015 SIS survival work explicitly announces star and complete graph expressions but no path-vs-star single-source ranking. No direct matching theorem was found after substantive source/alias searches. The 2015 paper could not be read in full and a previously published small-graph table could cover part of the result; these limitations are specific residual risks.
residual_risks: Full article DOI:10.1103/PhysRevE.92.032806 remained inaccessible, so it might include exact four-vertex examples or a path comparison in uninspected sections.
An unindexed small-graph SIS/contact-process enumeration could imply a portion or all of the source-position switching theorem.
Source-date and ecological model are old; the mathematical finding is new work rather than a claim that the cited papers proved it.

value.rationale: Single-site ecological introduction is a natural intervention parameter. The theorem exactly determines every ranking among four source/network choices with identical numbers of patches and links, where simple centrality comparisons alone do not predict the switch. It yields a strict site-placement change at a uniquely specified colonization/extinction ratio, a scientifically motivated finite-case structural boundary rather than an arbitrary isolated polynomial computation. The ecology of larger or heterogeneous networks and empirical detectability are deliberately not asserted.
